profile.headline: What are we making now?
profile.summary: Some specialties I would offer: Golang, NixOS, K8s

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: In the EAA Integrations team, building Go and Rust services for internal help center APIs, with reproducible dev/build environments on NixOS via Nix flakes. Updating k8s and infra configs per request, and improving deployment reliability with automated CI/CD pipelines and observability dashboards. Leading junior engineers on daily tasks, troubleshooting, and code reviews.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: In the Audio Space team, developed Go and Rust based lint tools to improve the pipeline. Managed CI/CD scripts to add the tools as a part of developer workflow and privacy regulation requested by FTC. Automated static analysis gates that reduced manual review overhead across the team's services.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: The Migrations team developed Go cloud services to manage large-scale file migrations between on-premise and cloud storage. Self-managed Kubernetes clusters were deployed and maintained to facilitate scalable petabyte-scale transfers. Guidance was also provided to junior engineers working on cross-platform tool development and associated technical issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: On the Retail Solutions team, we developed Android tablet applications to provide integrated customer services within retail stores. We also delivered a Linux device driver and NDK wrapper for HP POS and printer systems, and integrated various POS peripherals such as cameras, scales, barcode readers, and wired/wireless sensors. Furthermore, we actively contributed to HP's custom Linux distribution development for edge servers.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: The Lighting Control team developed baremetal and RTOS firmware for nRF52 and STM32 MCUs using C. Peripherals were managed via I2C, SPI, RS232/485, and CAN protocols, along with the resolution of battery drain issues related to MCU power modes. MQTT and CoAP services were also delivered using Python and Golang for wireless demonstration applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: Within the Test Automation team, baremetal/RTOS firmware was developed using C for ABOV's MCU series in both automotive and digital appliance testing applications. The team's efforts encompassed the design of PCB circuits to integrate these MCUs with customer industrial solutions, and the utilization of LabVIEW for controlling test equipment and environments specific to digital sensor testing.

educations.schoolName: Seoul National University of Science and Technology
